request.description: Loan categories with amount limits (integer paise), tenure options (months), purposes and availability. With `segment`, only that segment's categories in its display order. `illustrativeRateBps` is only for clearly labelled example EMIs, never an offer. `availability.available` stays false until a verified lender route covers the category (lender module, M4). Optional `pincode` is used for availability.

response.name: 200 OK
